rationale: The agent located the user and identified pending orders, but proceeded to cancel two orders without first confirming with the user, violating the explicit requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The agent also supplied a cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”) without asking the user, and presented refund amounts and item details without visible confirmation from tool outputs. While authentication appears minimally performed and actions targeted the correct user’s orders, the lack of pre-action confirmation is a clear policy breach, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
